whenToUse: Toolbars of removable filter chips over a table or list, one field, condition and value per chip
Nested AND and OR condition builders, hung off a trigger over a report or laid out inline
Attribute catalogs too large or deep to list at once, and option lists paged from a server

whenNotToUse.when: A finished record table with its chip bar, paging and row actions already built
Storefront product facets with price sliders, color swatches and department pills
One day or span of days picked on its own, with no attribute or condition

agentNotes: `renderValue`, `icon` and a component `editor` count toward the schema index by presence only, so swapping one alone keeps serving the old one
A rule reaches `onQueryChange` unfinished: an empty `operator`, or a `value` still undefined or empty where its `arity` is not none; skip it when compiling
Negate swaps to an operator's `inverse` where one exists and otherwise sets `negated`, as on `starts_with`, so a compiler must read `negated`
